verdict_reason: The file is the rebase fix bringing back the pre-Design Release 2.1 card, which undoes EUDPA-696's merged rename, id, title and change-action helper.

todos.issue: Rebase fix 714a8f5 ('Restore the pre-rebase check-answers view model') re-creates this file, which main's EUDPA-696 (#484, Design Release 2.1) renamed to cards/consignment/additional-details.js. Against main it reverts that merged work, none of which EUDPA-776 (remove the contact address page) asks for: export additionalDetailsCard -> additionalAnimalDetailsCard (line 15), card id 'additionalDetails' -> 'additionalAnimalDetails' (line 21), title copy.cards.additionalDetails ('Additional details') -> copy.cards.additionalAnimalDetails ('Additional animal details', line 22), hidden text key (line 28), and changeAction -> cardAction (lines 7, 24). The review card title no longer matches openspec/specs/live-animals/journey-pages/check-your-answers/spec.md:27 ('Additional details') or the DR2.1 copy main ships. The same commit reverses DR2.1's renames across the sibling cards (import-details, reason-for-import, species-cards, transit-countries).
todos.fix: Must: the PR's diff against main for this card holds only changes EUDPA-776 needs, so the card keeps main's file name (additional-details.js), export, id, 'Additional details' title, hidden text and changeAction. One way: drop this file and restore main's additional-details.js (git checkout origin/main -- <path>), then re-resolve 714a8f5 against main's check-answers view model rather than the pre-rebase one, keeping only the contact-address removals.
